items.title: It will be interesting to see whether the Hawks use Dorian Finney-Smith, Jalen Wilson, both, or neither in this game.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
It will be interesting to see whether the Hawks use Dorian Finney-Smith, Jalen Wilson, both, or neither in this game.

If they choose "neither," it will either be a lot of Corey Kispert and or a ton of Zuby Ejiofor (who is also the backup center).

items.title: Will be interesting to see if the Hawks use Dorian Finney-Smith in the second half.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Will be interesting to see if the Hawks use Dorian Finney-Smith in the second half.

Only other option (even with Dort playing a ton at the 4) would be a stint or two with Zuby + Okongwu.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text: Asa Newell (left great toe hyperextension) is OUT for the rest of the game.
